I've got a couple for different situations (a big one at home, a smaller one in the car, etc) but the main points are: - A multitool (currently Leatherman Wave with the Bit Kit and bit extender).

  • A good folding knife (Spyderco Deliva 4) and fixed blade (Gerber LMF 2).

  • Food (between 24 and 72 hours depending on the bag).

  • A change of clothes (underware, base layer, mid layer, shell) in separate waterproof bags.

  • Fire lighting tools (cigarette lighter, flint and steel, AND matches, because 'why not?')

  • First aid (exact content varies by situation and risk factors).

  • Paracord.

  • A bivvy.

  • Broken in boots and good socks.

  • Cash.

  • Toilet paper.

  • A good torch (currently a Ledlenser P17, but thinking of upgrading) and spare batteries.

  • A hand held UHF radio.

Some may say 'wheres your gun!?' and to that I have two answers...

  1. I'm Australian, so they're all locked at home in my safe.

  2. My go bag is build situationally. The content above is the staples that never change, but in the right circumstances it could contain a firearm or a bow.
